description: Korean subcontract direct payment (하도급대금 직접 지급, 하도급법 제14조): the client (발주자) must pay the subcontractor directly when the prime contractor stops payment, goes bankrupt or loses its license (on request), the three parties agree, the prime missed 2+ installments (on request), or the prime gave no payment guarantee (on request); blocked when the prime documents the subcontractor's own wage or material arrears (③); limited to what the client has not yet paid the prime (④). Also late interest at 15.5% a year after 60 days from delivery (제13조⑧, FTC notice).

daysSinceDelivery.description: Days since delivery or completion was accepted

missedInstallments.description: Installments the prime has not paid

ownerUnpaidToPrime.description: Amount the client still owes the prime for that work (KRW)

primeStopRequest.description: The prime documented the subcontractor's wage/material arrears and asked the client to stop

receivedFromPrime.description: Amount already received from the prime (KRW)

requested.description: The subcontractor asked the client for direct payment

workValue.description: Subcontract price of the work done (KRW)
